meta.title: Native provider capabilities
meta.description: Direct provider tools for images, document understanding, short video and WAV speech. Reuses DSH credentials, workspace policy and attachments; no MCP hop. Configure providers and per-operation defaults before use. Use existing Office tools for editing/recalculation and present for delivery cards. Selected inputs are sent to the configured provider. Disabling removes these tools/search provider, not saved artifacts. Microphone input and inline audio preview are separate integrations, not included in this initial Host bundle.
